If you believe that clothes and other products can have a second life instead of ending up as waste, this job could be something for you. Give things a second life - and start a new chapter for yourself. For our client, an international company focused on giving used items a second life, we are looking for warehouse employees for parcel sorting in Breda. The company processes parcels containing second-hand items sent by individual customers through a large network of drop-off points. At the warehouse in Breda, these parcels are sorted and distributed to different regions across the Benelux. Your job The parcels arrive at the warehouse by truck and are placed on a conveyor belt, where they are automatically sorted into different regions. Your tasks will include: - placing parcels on the conveyor belt with the barcode facing upwards; - making sure the parcels can be correctly scanned and sorted by the machine; - manually sorting parcels according to postcode; - removing full containers or bags with sorted parcels; - transporting full containers or bags to the loading dock. Some bags can weigh approximately 10-15 kg, so you should be physically able to handle and move these safely. No previous warehouse experience is required. The work is straightforward and you will receive training on the job. What do we expect from you?
